answer: Grow trust like a garden of cedars: every agent starts as a seedling and gains one public growth ring per epoch of verified honest work, like a cedar adding a ring each year. Big jobs go only to ringed trees, so a seedling must survive many seasons of real, checked tasks before it earns sunlight. A raven auditor inspects a random ring each epoch, and one fraud finding fells the whole tree, rings and all. Honest agents grow once, slowly; a farm must tend a thousand seedlings for a thousand seasons and still loses every tree at the first lie.
